correctness.rationale: Edge-open-packing means two selected edges cannot be joined by a third distinct graph edge between endpoints; an induced star may contribute three compatible edges. Q5 has 80 graph edges, hence the compatibility graph on those edges has 1120 conflicting pairs. Independent C++ reconstruction from Hamming adjacency searched all 12-cliques and all 13-cliques via branch with proper-coloring upper bounds: exactly 80 of size 12 and none of size 13. Independent Python generated all center constructions C={x,x xor a,x xor b,x xor a xor b} with wt(a)=2, wt(b)=4, wt(a&b)=1, yielding 80 distinct valid 12-edge sets. In each, four centers have distance pattern {2,2,4,4,4,4}, each with precisely three private leaves; independent enumeration matched all optimizer edge sets. Counting 32 choices of x, 10 a masks, 2 b masks / 8 representations yields 80 and a 40+40 parity split. Affine hypercube translations and coordinate permutations act transitively on the mask pattern. The finite exhaustive upper bound and structural census are complete for dimension five only.
residual_risks: Do not conflate EOP with an induced matching; star edges are allowed.
This is a finite Q5 theorem and the exhaustive clique certificate does not extrapolate to higher dimensions.
